sections.changelog:
0.16.12

  • Import Rent Manager property marketing descriptions from Online Listings into the existing property description field.
  • Preserve saved copy on failed requests or unlisted properties, and accept blank descriptions from successful responses.
  • Record description diagnostics without blocking property, unit, or floorplan syncing.
  • Requires Rent Fetch API 0.4.12 for description importing. Older APIs preserve saved copy during rolling updates.
